6 تَخَاطَرَتِ الفُحُولُ بِأَذْنَابِهَا [The stallions of the camels lashed with their tails] previously to their attacking one another. (A.) ＝
-A2- تخاطروا (tropical:) They laid bets, wagers, or stakes, one with another, (K, TA,) عَلَى أَمْرٍ for a thing. (TA.) And تخاطرا عَلَيْهِ (tropical:) They two laid bets, wagers, or stakes, for it. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
